description: Reviewed missing-type limitations for the real CPU Torch 2.14.1 / ONNX 1.23.2 audit. Original failures remain visible; positive diagnostics are never allowed.

allowed_failures.reason: Result member metadata was not resolved
allowed_failures.explanation: MultivariateNormal.covariance_matrix uses a custom lazy_property descriptor. Its Tensor receiver type is not recovered, so the subsequent numel member remains unknown despite valid native execution.

allowed_failures.reason: Known invalid argument was not diagnosed
allowed_failures.explanation: The GraphProto annotation resolves through generated protobuf stubs without enough nominal dispatch evidence to reject a string. Native make_model rejects that string.

allowed_failures.reason: Known invalid argument was not diagnosed
allowed_failures.explanation: The ndarray stub reference does not prove nominal incompatibility with a Python list. Native numpy_helper.from_array rejects the list.
